articles.title: The Witcher 4 Confirmed for 2028 Release in Official CD Projekt Gamescom 2026 Announcement
articles.summary: The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window, CD Projekt has confirmed.
articles.body:
The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window, CD Projekt has confirmed.

The announcement comes via a special video message from Michał Nowakowski, Joint Chief Executive Officer, CD Projekt Red. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034.

Nowakowski said CD Projekt will show off The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion Songs of the Past at gamescom this week, including "a taste of its dark story" and the new content.

Every CD Projekt Red Game In Development

Eslewhere, Nowakowski confirmed The Witcher 4 will not be at gamescom 2026. "Our team here at CD Projekt Red HQ is hard at work on a brand new saga, one with Siri at the helm. We have more than 500 incredibly talented developers working to create something truly special for you. The Witcher 4 features a huge and immersive open world, intense and action-packed gameplay, and a deep, impactful story that we hope will stay with you for a long time. Simply put, this is our biggest, boldest, and most ambitious game to date.

"Now I know you're eager to learn when it's coming. That's the question we're hearing from you all the time. So while we're not showing The Witcher 4 at the event, and we're not ready to share an exact date, I can tell you this: The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window.

"I know it's a bit of a wait and you'd love to play it sooner, but let the team cook. It will be worth the wait. Until then, there will be plenty more of The Witcher to come, including Songs of the Past when it launches in 2027. And you can be sure gamescom is also in our plans for the coming years."

Songs of the Past is the third expansion for CD Projekt’s fantasy masterpiece, and is due out 12 years after the original game came out and 11 years after the much-loved second expansion, Blood and Wine. CD Projekt is co-developing the expansion with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising "industry veterans" who worked on The Witcher 3. Here’s what we know so far.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past first details:

Songs of the Past is the third expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt

It will launch in 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC

CD Projekt Red is co-developing Songs of the Past with Fool’s Theory

Songs of the Past will return players to the role of legendary monster slayer Geralt of Rivia for a brand new adventure when it launches in 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

CD Projekt has suggested Songs of the Past will help set the stage for The Witcher 4 . While telling a standalone story starring Geralt set after the events of The Witcher 3, the new adventure will also act as a prologue of sorts to The Witcher 4.

Speaking to investors in May, Nowakowski was questioned on how the expansion is being positioned in the franchise, why it will launch in 2027 after previously being expected this year, and whether any of CD Projekt's new trilogy of The Witcher games will also receive expansions, as The Witcher 3 has.

"First and foremost, we really wanted to deliver a great experience to the fans, a really cool expansion that's going to make people happy that they can come back to The Witcher 3 setting," Nowakowski said, discussing why Songs of the Past was being made in the first place.

"Of course, indirectly, yes, it is a reminder [of the franchise for fans]. It is, in a way, a prologue, although it's not a prologue in a verbatim way of [being] a prologue for the actual The Witcher 4. Yes, you can look at it as it's a way to maintain certain chatter on The Witcher 3. All of those are side effects, additional side effects. The core thing for us, from our perspective, is really delivering a high-quality, fun experience to the existing fans of The Witcher."

"We had a moment where our plans assumed that Songs of the Past would be released this year," Nowakowski said, when questioned why the expansion was launching later than expected. "We decided together with the development team, that the game will be launching in 2027, to be honest, to achieve the best possible result from the consumer standpoint, which in the end, frankly speaking, is the only ultimate thing that really matters."

During a livestream aimed at The Witcher fans, CD Projekt gave a few further hints on the expansion's focus, teasing the importance of Geralt's new third sword — as glimpsed in a recent piece of artwork released to celebrate a springtime festival. Geralt's bard buddy Dandelion is also present.

"We won't give too much away right now because we want you to experience it as you play," senior community and social media manager Laura Beitzel teased during the 10th anniversary livestream designed to celebrate Blood and Wine.

"But as a few eagle-eyed people have already seen over the past 24 hours, there are some hints waiting for you on a very important evening in Witcher lore, Belleteyn Night, in our Belleteyn celebration that we shared a few weeks ago. So... keep looking for clues."

Here, Beitzel is referencing a piece of artwork and a poem it posted on social media in April. It shows Geralt resting by a bonfire as Dandelion plays the lute while villagers dance. More importantly, though, it shows Geralt with a mysterious new sword — the same sword he's also holding in Songs of the Past's reveal artwork, which sports an unusual ornate curved crossguard.

"So yes, Geralt is holding a sword," CD Projekt's Amelia Korzycka continued, referencing Songs of the Past's key artwork. "It is a very important sword for the story and you will get to know it when the game comes out. So a few more streams before that when [we] reveal it."

Beitzel also discussed the size of the expansion. "Songs of the Past will be aligned with what you're familiar with in Blood and Wine, and what you've come to experience and expect from us when we do our expansions," Beitzel explained. "It's an expansion, let's make it clear."

We also have confirmation that Songs of the Past will include more Gwent cards, and that CD Projekt was still working on cross-platform mod support for The Witcher 3, to launch at some point in the future.

CD Projekt has yet to show Songs of the Past off in any way since it announced the expansion in May , so I expect we’ll see a trailer and, hopefully, some gameplay at ONL on August 25. The show kicks off at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm UK time / 8pm CEST.

The Witcher 3 recently hit an astonishing 65 million copies sold (it only seemed right that The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim hit the same sales milestone just a few months later ).

Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: The Folio Society Reveals The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past
articles.summary: If you can stomach the price, The Folio Society's gorgeous hardcover The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past is the ultimate collectible for fans of Liu Cixin's sci-fi epic.
articles.body:
Liu Cixin's The Three-Body Problem trilogy is widely regarded as one of the best science fiction epics of the modern era, and that story has reached an even wider audience lately thanks to the Netflix series. If you're a fan of the books and want to own them in the finest version possible, then you'll be pleased to know that The Folio Society is releasing a lavish new hardcover called The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past.

IGN can exclusively debut some of Matt Griffin's stunning artwork featured inside this illustrated hardcover. Get a closer look in the slideshow gallery below:

The Folio Society's The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past - Preview Gallery

The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past collects all three books in the series - The Three-Body Problem, The Dark Forest, and Death's End. The book features art and design work by Griffin and includes a brand-new introduction by the author never before published in English.

The Folio Society's official description teases:

The 1344-page limited edition will feature a special box design, lining, frontispiece, cover design, as well as 3 black & white integrated title-page spreads (one for each book in the trilogy), and 15 color illustrations including 3 double page spreads, all by the award-winning illustrator Matt Griffin. Bound in printed cloth with a design by Matt Griffin and blocked lettering by Steve O Connell, the limited edition also features blocked endpapers on Sirio Color Dark Blue paper, a ribbon marker, printed book edges, an outer Clamshell covered in holographic blocked cloth, and a copper holographic blocked paper lining. The lining features real three-body simulations created by Matt Griffin using a program from MIT which he received special permission to use.

“Starting with the Chinese Cultural Revolution and spanning some 18 million years into the future, Liu Cixin's masterpiece is as broad as it is compelling,” said Folio Society Editor James Rose in a statement. “A tale of humanity's struggle, and that of a civilisation fighting for its very existence, this dares to answer the question: 'Are we alone in the Universe?'. Beautifully and brilliant evoked in Matt Griffin's artwork, this is the ultimate edition of a science-fiction phenomenon. Fans of the series, anyone interested in sci-fi and hard science, and new readers alike will be awestruck by this edition.”

The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past is priced at £550 / US $780 and will be available to preorder beginning on September 8 on the Folio Society website .

In IGN's 3 Body Problem review , Jordan Hoffman writes, "3 Body Problem reworks Cixin Liu’s mammoth book trilogy for a wider audience to great success, though it may annoy some viewers with its far-out sci-fi and speed-of-light plot machinations. Some sequences work better than others – like the video game side story delivering a soupçon of cringe – but many of the performances and one shocking sequence make for a more-than-worthy adaption of the beloved franchise."

Save 23% Off Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol. 2 (Steam)

Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol. 2 (Steam)

Finally, there’s Metal Gear: Ghost Babel, which is billed as a “bonus” inclusion in this collection. It’s a non-canon entry that originally released for Game Boy in 2000. Personally, I do most of my gaming on Steam Deck, so I preordered this collection at this discounted price. It’ll be great to have Metal Gear Solid 4 on modern platforms for the first time in years. And I’m sure Peace Walker will feel right at home on the handheld hardware. I have my doubts that Ghost Babel will keep me enthralled long enough to complete it, but I’ll definitely check it out.

articles.title: Lanterns Fans Say Episode 2 Is Hiding a Classic Green Lantern Villain in Plain Sight
articles.summary: Lanterns Episode 2 is here, and fans believe it's hiding a vicious Green Lantern villain in plain sight.
articles.body:
Lanterns Episode 2 is here, and fans believe it's hiding a vicious Green Lantern villain in plain sight.

Warning! Lanterns Season 1 Episode 2 spoilers follow.

There's some extraterrestrial activity in Rushville, Nebraska, and Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) is determined to get to the bottom of it. While he's off constructing a plan to get dead bodies out of the morgue and through town, John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) is sent on a fetch quest to bring back a big green battery and keep his little bird safe. The Green Lantern-in-training doesn't make it too far before he's ambushed and kidnapped for a quick chat about what is said to be a new threat to Earth: Manhunters.

It's here viewers run into Paul Ben-Victor's Antaan, the leader of a group of aliens looking to root out a Manhunter who's believed to be taking shelter in Rushville. He's threatened to level the town if John isn't able to unmask the Manhunter within 48 hours, but some fans suspect we've already encountered one of the most infamous supervillains the Green Lantern Corps has ever known.

Antaan is definitely Atrocitus. The vibe I get from him just makes me think that’s who he actually is. pic.twitter.com/acPYDlFmmB — DC Universe Daily (@DCdaily) August 24, 2026

Antaan is definitely Atrocitus. The vibe I get from him just makes me think that’s who he actually is. pic.twitter.com/acPYDlFmmB

During his meeting with John, Antaan says the Manhunters are responsible for wiping out his people, going as far as to forcibly project their supposed atrocities into John's mind. It just so happens that backstory shares a few things in common with the Red Lanterns and their angry alien bad guy, Atrocitus.

Past incarnations of the Red Lantern are also known to have suffered at the hands of the Manhunters, and with fans looking for Antaan's other connections to the DC universe, Atrocitus is who is making the most sense. Where Green Lanterns use will to build their Constructs and Yellow Lanterns use fear, Red Lanterns are driven by their rage, potentially presenting a vengeful entity for Hal and John to deal with as Lanterns progresses.

Considering Atrocitus typically looks bigger and meaner than Ben-Victor's character, these loosely connected dots might not have you convinced another classic DC villain will be joining Sinestro in this latest jump to the live-action DCU. However, fans aren't letting up.

yeah this guy’s definitely Atrocitus https://t.co/lGYEtv8ej8 — Drew ꗞ (@GoodNightDrew) August 24, 2026

yeah this guy’s definitely Atrocitus https://t.co/lGYEtv8ej8

This mf is defo Atrocitus pic.twitter.com/qz6f61ESON — Charlie 🐧 (@CharliePengMoji) August 24, 2026

This mf is defo Atrocitus pic.twitter.com/qz6f61ESON

SE PREPAREM PQ O VILÃO MAIS FODA DO LANTERNA VERDE VULGO ATROCITUS ESTÁ CHEGANDO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/NKQCuq4Cli — O Gui 🍐! dcnauta orgulhoso (@Birdsofpera) August 24, 2026

SE PREPAREM PQ O VILÃO MAIS FODA DO LANTERNA VERDE VULGO ATROCITUS ESTÁ CHEGANDO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/NKQCuq4Cli

When Deadline first reported that Ben-Victor would be joining the Green Lantern show, it described his character as "an extraterrestrial devoted to exposing the truth and exacting vengeance against those who wronged his people. Consumed by a deep and unrelenting hatred for the law, he is determined to deliver justice on his own terms."

That certainly sounds a bit more like the Atrocitus we know from the comics. When you consider that Lanterns has already established its world as one populated by aliens who can conceal their identities, it's not outside of the realm of possibility that the Red Lantern leader might have a mask of his own.

Meanwhile, Episode 2 isn't the first time Atrocitus theories have popped up online. Last week, user 'I_warisha,' for example, took to Reddit to draw connections between major events happening in years ending with the number six and Sector 666. It seemed like more of a reach at the time, but as the pieces come together, it wind up being a sneaky Easter Egg for what's to come.

"Probably Atrocitus and the massacre he referred to was probably the Massacre of Sector 666," another fan online suggested .

"There's just no way Paul Ben-Victor's character isn't Atrocitus," another theorized . "In the comics the manhunters are the ones who wiped out Atrocitus' planet including his family. The way he's speaking about it here perfectly lines up with that, and like he was there to see it, too."

As Lanterns is just taking off , it's hard to say just how many fan-favorite characters it will pull into the DC in its first season. For now, all we know about the rest of the story is that it certainly seems like Hal Jordan will meet an untimely demise at some point before all eight episodes are up. John Stewart, at least, seems headed for a bright future in the DCU, as Pierre is already confirmed to show up in Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow .

While we wait for Episode 3 to arrive this Sunday, you can check out IGN's review and recap for Episode 2 , and you can see what showrunner Chris Mundy had to say about it , too. For more, be sure to see how DC Studios co-CEO defended the evolving tone of the DCU .

articles.title: The Long Game: The 4 Best Crops to Invest in Early in Stardew Valley
articles.body:
We’re starting a new series at IGN called The Long Game, where we focus on things you can invest in early in new or popular games that will pay off in the long run. We’re starting this series with Stardew Valley, which celebrated its 10-year anniversary this year and is one of the most successful indie games of all time.

If you’ve never played Stardew Valley before, it’s a farming and life sim where you leave your job at a soulless corporation to manage a farm left to you by your deceased grandfather. The farm has seen better days, so it’s up to you to restore it to its former glory. That means clearing the land, tilling the soil, planting and watering seeds, and upgrading your home and equipment to gather items more efficiently.

As you might expect, those upgrades cost money. There are several ways to make that money, like fishing and mining, but harvesting and selling crops is the best way to keep a steady stream of income. And there are four specific plants that are the most cost-effective options at your disposal.

But before we get into those specific plants, we have some general farming tips for you to be aware of. First, you normally need to water your seeds every day for them to properly grow. But if it’s a rainy day, you can skip that step and let Mother Nature handle it for you. Check the TV in your farmhouse to see the weather report, which will tell you when rain is coming and help you plan ahead.

We also highly recommend crafting scarecrows and sprinklers as soon as you’re able to. Birds can sometimes swoop in and eat the crops you worked hard to grow, but scarecrows prevent that. And sprinklers will automatically water the area around them, allowing you to skip hand watering even when it’s not raining.

And finally, the seasons change every 28 days in Stardew Valley and almost every crop is seasonal, meaning they will wither when a new season begins. Since the game starts in spring, those are the crops we’ll be focusing on to gain wealth as early as possible and set you up for success.

This starter crop will be the foundation on which you build the rest of your farming journey. You get your first few seeds for free, and after that you can buy more for 20 gold each at Pierre’s General Store. They grow in four days, then can be sold back to Pierre for 35 gold each. Getting back nearly double what you paid for them can really add up in the long run, and it’s a good idea to keep a handful of parsnips planted throughout your first spring.

Because they have such a short growth time, if you stagger them with other crops, you’ll have consistent money coming in. But of course, this is just the start. Once you’ve made a little cash, you can incorporate the next crop into the mix.

You don’t need to boil ’em, mash ’em, or stick ’em in a stew to make potatoes worthwhile. They cost 50 gold at Pierre’s and can be sold back for 80, so there’s obviously more upfront cost but the profit is double that of parsnips. They also take six days to sprout, which is why you shouldn’t move on to exclusively farming these, just add them to the rotation.

While that’s all well and good, the true value of potatoes comes from the possibility of getting a double harvest. Every time you pull a potato from the ground, it has a 20% chance of having a surprise second potato with it. That requires some luck, but it’s a nice boost to your profits when it happens. And its sell price can help you move on to farming the next crop on the list.

A cauliflower seed costs 80 gold, the same amount you get back for selling a harvested potato. And you can sell cauliflower for a whopping 175 gold, giving it one of the biggest profit margins of any spring crop. The downside is that it takes 12 days to grow, which is nearly half the season. So you have to pay attention to the timing of when you plant them.

But if you’re patient and use the funds from harvesting potatoes to grow cauliflower, then you’re basically starting with a 50 gold investment into potato seeds and getting back 175 gold in the end. Plus, you’ll get a letter from Jodi requesting a fresh cauliflower, which she’ll give you 250 gold for. So it pays to be prepared ahead of time.

Our last recommendation is the most involved and requires a different approach to get the most out of it, but it’s the poster child for an early investment having a huge payoff down the line. You’ll first be able to buy strawberries during the Egg Festival on the 13th day of spring, where they cost 100 gold each. That’s expensive, but trust us, it’s worth it.

Make sure you have enough money to buy at least a handful, then plant most of the seeds immediately. Notice that we said most, not all. You should save some, and you’ll see why in a minute. Strawberries take eight days to grow, but once they mature, they’ll regrow a new strawberry in four days. And there’s a chance of you harvesting an extra strawberry, though the odds are much lower than potatoes. They sell for 120 apiece, and if you plant them ASAP, you’ll be able to harvest them twice before the first spring ends, meaning you can get 240 gold back for the 100 you spent on the original seed.

That’s a nice profit, but you’ll really start making bank once spring comes back around. In the second spring, on Day 1 you can plant the strawberry seeds you saved. With the ability to now take advantage of the full season, if you use a Speed-Gro fertilizer when you initially plant it, you can harvest strawberries six times. That’s a total of 720 gold made from the original 100 gold purchase, with any double harvests you luck into adding even more profit.

And that’s our list. If you’re hopping into Stardew Valley for the first time, was this helpful? Or if you’re a seasoned vet, was there something we missed? Let us know in the comments, and for more in The Long Game series, stay tuned to IGN.

articles.title: ESPN Unlimited Is Celebrating Its First Anniversary With a Price Hike
articles.summary: ESPN Unlimited and ESPN Select are getting price hikes next month, making one Disney+ bundle more valuable than ever.
articles.body:
According to a support page on ESPN’s website , both ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited are getting price hikes.

Starting September 17, ESPN Unlimited plans will be increasing by $2, while ESPN Select plans get a smaller $1 hike. The ESPN increases will also affect the price of the existing Disney+ bundle with ESPN Select, though ESPN Unlimited bundles will seemingly retain the same monthly pricing.

ESPN Price Hike Taking Effect September 17

ESPN Unlimited first launched almost exactly a year ago, in August 2025. The service was pitched as a particularly inclusive sports streaming service in an otherwise complicated landscape of divided licenses and leagues. ESPN Select launched at the same time to functionally replace ESPN+, with existing subscribers automatically moved over to the new plan.

ESPN has admittedly grown its content offerings since that initial launch. MLB.tv was moved to the ESPN app starting with the 2026 season, and a sublicensing deal with The CW expanded the service’s roster of college sports . More recently, ESPN acquired NFL media assets , and the NFL Network just became available to Unlimited plan subscribers on July 30.

Disney+ increased its own prices by a similar $2 margin last October . For its standalone plans, ESPN is following a similar approach of announcing the hike several weeks before it goes into effect for both new and returning subscribers, giving potential “new” customers an extra incentive to sign up before then.

Unlike the standalone ESPN plans, the price increase on the Disney+ bundle with ESPN Select has already gone into effect for new subscribers. The fact that the price increase doesn’t seem to be touching the ESPN Unlimited bundles increases the “value” of those bundles, assuming subscribers would already be interested in all three services.

It’s also worth nothing that the price hike trend extends far beyond the Disney ecosystem. Paramount+ and Netflix both announced price hikes earlier this year, while Peacock just increased its own streaming plan prices for the fourth time in four years. Will there ever be an endpoint to the price hikes? Here’s to hoping.

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who, when she isn't following streaming news, spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Kit Harington Takes Over as Gilderoy Lockhart After Nicholas Hoult Exits HBO's Harry Potter Season 2
articles.summary: Game of Thrones alum Kit Harington has reportedly stepped in to fill the role of Gilderoy Lockhart in Harry Potter Season 2, replacing Nicholas Hoult in a surprise recasting decision for the HBO show.
articles.body:
Game of Thrones alum Kit Harington has reportedly stepped in to fill the role of Gilderoy Lockhart in Harry Potter Season 2, replacing Nicholas Hoult in a surprise recasting decision for the HBO show.

The Jon Snow actor officially filled the role following the news that Hoult had taken the part of the Defense Against the Dark Arts professor earlier this month, according to Deadline . Scheduling issues are said to be the cause of his exit, as HBO struggled to work around two of his pre-existing projects when the shooting schedule was changed.

When it was determined Hoult would no longer be able to join the Hogwarts staff, HBO dug through its history with the Game of Thrones cast to pick up Harington instead. It's unclear if the Harry Potter show's second season will change with the recast, though Deadline reported that the actor behind Westeros' defender in the North is already excited to play Gilderoy Lockhart.

Harington is best known for his work on Game of Thrones, but he also appeared as Dane Whitman in Marvel's Eternals, Henry Muck in Industry, and Salen Kotch in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Although it might be a surprise to see him take over for Hoult in Harry Potter Season 2, Hogwarts — and even the part he will play — aren't uncharted territory for the actor.

He was one of the many A-listers to lend their voice to Audible's Full-Cast Audio Editions for the Harry Potter book series last year. While the project featured Keira Knightley as Professor Umbridge and James McAvoy as Mad-Eye Moody, Harington played Gilderoy Lockhart. His work must have made a good enough impression with those at HBO, as he's now set to reprise the role in live-action for Season 2.

"I read it, and like so many generations, I was entranced, and then I was a huge fan all through my teenage years," Harington told Audible, as shared by Deadline. "I think there’s a little bit of Gilderoy Lockhart in all of us," he added.

Gilderoy Lockhart first made his live-action debut in 2002's Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets. Alongside the then-leading trio of Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, and Emma Watson, he was portrayed by Kenneth Branagh.

HBO renewed Harry Potter for Season 2 in May , with reports at the time suggesting filming was scheduled to begin this fall. Season 1, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, is set to transport viewers to a TV series take on Harry (Dominic McLaughlin), Ron (Alastair Stout), and Hermione's (Arabella Stanton) story this Christmas .

articles.title: Pokémon Collector Poses as Buyer to Recover $4,000 Worth of Stolen Cards in 'Vigilante' Sting Operation
articles.summary: Canadian collector Emilio Kihien took matters into his own hands after police said they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover $4,000 worth of stolen Pokemon cards.
articles.body:
Canadian collector Emilio Kihien took matters into his own hands after police said they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover $4,000 worth of stolen Pokémon cards.

Kihien was conducting what he thought was a standard sale for a few highly-graded, officially-encapsulated Pokémon trading cards at his home in Coquitlam when the buyers handed him $4,000 in phony bills, snatched the goods, and ran. Kihien gave chase, even hanging onto the side of the thieves’ getaway car before falling onto the road, suffering bruising and a painful bout of road rash as a result.

His next step was to contact police — but he says authorities told him they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover his stolen property. According to Kihien, one officer even told him it’d be better to try and catch the culprits himself.

We Build LEGO Pokémon Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise

“The police response — they really didn’t seem like they were gonna help me that much. One of the officers literally said, ‘If it was me, I’d probably just try to set them up myself,’" he told local outlet CTV News .

A few days later, one of Kihien’s buddies came across a listing for the stolen cards online. The thieves even used the exact same images Kihien had included in his original posting.

“I’m just thinking, you know what, these guys can’t be the most intelligent of people,” he remarked.

Acting quickly, Kihien and his friends posed as interested buyers, and set up an exchange at the Metropolis at Metrotown in Burnaby on August 13, where they detained the alleged thieves until police arrived. Reports state one adult and one juvenile were detained, who could face criminal charges including theft.

Kihien recorded the entire ordeal on his smart glasses, showing himself and his friends blocking the suspects from leaving the Barnaby mall. And while their sting operation proved successful, police are urging future victims of theft against such measures.

“Vigilantism can only cause problems,” Royal Canadian Mounted Police Corporal Mike Kalanj said. “No one knows who has weapons. Even as the victim, if you show up and you harm someone, now you’re looking at charges, as well.”

The stolen cards went mostly unharmed, though one case was cracked in the altercations. The haul included three 2023 Pokémon Mew EN Special Illustration Rare EX cards (for Blastoise, Venusaur, and Charizard), graded a PSA 10 — meaning the agency could find no flaws with them , whatsoever.

This is the latest Pokémon TCG crime to make headlines after a pair of thieves in Britain were locked up for making off with £71,000 ($95,000) worth of stock after their getaway van broke down in July.

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Adds New Dynamic Cosmetic Options for Certain Characters Like Ghost
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is adding more options for how your operators appear in-game.
articles.body:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is adding more options for how your operators appear in-game.

The recently released Modern Warfare 4 beta has given players their first look at a ton of features, maps, and other content that will be available in the final game. Some of these things were heavily advertised before launch, such as the fluidity of movement and a new system that randomly generates gun builds for you.

One feature that was kept under wraps, however, allows players to equip different cosmetic items on the fly in-game. Ghost, for instance, can remove his mask (which comically reveals another cloth mask underneath) and put it back on. Valeria can equip a hockey mask. And Captain Price can smoke a cigar, which will appear on-screen in first-person at all times unless you take it out.

You Can Remove Ghost's Mask in Modern Warfare 4 using the NEW 'Operator Variant' Feature in the Emote Wheel: pic.twitter.com/ABJma6tvsy — DETONATED (@DETONATEDcom) August 23, 2026

You Can Remove Ghost's Mask in Modern Warfare 4 using the NEW 'Operator Variant' Feature in the Emote Wheel: pic.twitter.com/ABJma6tvsy

this is the best MW4 mastercraft the cigar actually stays in ur mouth until you respawn lol pic.twitter.com/sFWQUrV02k — B23 (@B23COD) August 21, 2026

this is the best MW4 mastercraft the cigar actually stays in ur mouth until you respawn lol pic.twitter.com/sFWQUrV02k

It's a fun touch and one that will almost certainly be taken advantage of in premium skins. As of right now, we're not sure what skins to expect in MW4, but Call of Duty has promised to keep things more grounded after fan backlash to previous games. Specifically, they said there will be "no Lady Gaga. No Omni-Man. No Teletubbies. No SpongeBob."

The fan reception on Modern Warfare 4's beta has been fairly divisive so far. Some fear that the game is a bit too fast, especially for having relatively small maps. The time-to-kill is extremely rapid, but Infinity Ward has addressed much of this feedback from fans so far. The studio has released patches for the beta addressing TTK, spawns, and is also looking to make improvements to the gunsmith system for launch.

IGN spoke with some of MW4's multiplayer leads last week ahead of the beta, and they made it clear this playtest is essential in helping shape the final game. "To me, this beta feels like the start of the conversation with the public, you know what I mean? We're excited to basically put that out there and we'll see what happens next. We want to just keep talking and keep learning and trying to find out what we can do better," said Jackie Reynolds, Modern Warfare 4's multiplayer design lead.

articles.title: Anirudh Pisharody Says He's 'So Down' to Play Nightcrawler in Marvel's X-Men Movie
articles.summary: 9-1-1’s Anirudh Pisharody is ready to take on the role of Nightcrawler for Marvel Studio’s upcoming X-Men reboot, and fans are rallying behind him.
articles.body:
9-1-1’s Anirudh Pisharody is ready to take on the role of Nightcrawler for Marvel Studio’s upcoming X-Men reboot, and fans are rallying behind him.

The cast of Marvel’s X-Men flick is still being fleshed out, leaving ample room for speculation as to who will be joining the already-confirmed list of stars. A few were confirmed at D23 this year, with Inde Navarrette revealed as Rogue, Maya Boyd as Storm, Christopher Abbott as Professor X, and Adam Driver as Mister Sinister.

There are a few notable mutants who have yet to be revealed as part of the film, one of whom is Nightcrawler. While Alan Cumming reprising the role in Avengers: Doomsday , Marvel’s X-Men movie is expected to be a reboot of the franchise, meaning that a different, younger actor could be stepping into the role moving forward.

Enter Anirudh Pisharody. He’s an Indian-American actor best known for his performances in Never Have I Ever and 9-1-1, with other notable roles in Big Sky, The Goldbergs, Last Man Standing, and Unit 234.

On August 23, Pisharody responded to a fan’s tweet showing a side-by-side of the actor and panels of Nightcrawler from the X-Men comics. “Anirudh would devour as Nightcrawler,” they wrote.

“So, so down,” Pisharody responded in a quote tweet, tagging Marvel Studios alongside the scheming devil face emoji.

so so down @MarvelStudios 😈 https://t.co/OAPM6lvOYP — Anirudh Pisharody (@AnirudhPish) August 23, 2026

so so down @MarvelStudios 😈 https://t.co/OAPM6lvOYP

Fans are flooding the comments section to vouch for him, with multiple users tagging Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige on several different platforms to make sure he’s aware of just how eager they are to see him in the role. (Still others are holding out hope that he'll take the role of Prince Naveen in Disney's upcoming live action Princess and the Frog remake .)

“Yes, make your move!” one excited fan wrote.

“I would be down if you could master a German accent,” another remarked.

“Role assigned to you already,” another wrote. “Remember me when it happens…”

Pisharody isn’t the only notable name vying for a role in Marvel’s X-Men movie; in a similar story, Reacher star Agnez Mo also responded to fan calls for Feige to cast her as Psylocke on social media.

“Thanks! I’m just gonna put it out to the universe… Psylocke,” she wrote, tagging the Marvel and Marvel Studios accounts.

Other names already confirmed for Marvel’s X-Men include Samara Weaving as Emma Frost (one of the most accurate castings we’ve seen thus far, to be frank), and Kit Connor as Cyclops.

articles.title: You Can Now Build a LEGO Millennium Pumpkin Ahead of Halloween
articles.body:
The LEGO community has long enjoyed the process of taking a seemingly normal set and turning it into the iconic Star Wars ship. LEGO has released a total of 12 official versions of the Millennium Falcon over the years, but one fan has taken it even further and created 19 alternate builds himself.

Brad Barber, known on Reddit as Minute_Food_2881, has made headlines before for his unique builds. You may recognize his name from the cursed Millennium Simba set last year. His most recent recreation utilizes the new LEGO Halloween Pumpkin Lantern that just released this August.

My Millennium Pumpkin alternate build of the 40872 Pumpkin Lantern. by u/Minute_Food_2881 in lego

Unlike some of Barber's previous MOCs (My Own Creation), the Millennium Pumpkin has the added benefit of actually lighting up. The Halloween Pumpkin Lantern set includes a light brick that would normally only be activated by pressing the stem. According to Barber, the Millenium Pumpkin will also activate when you place it on the stand.

Like other alternate builds Barber has created, this version of the Falcon can be created entirely with pieces from the original set. The Halloween Pumpkin Lantern set includes a light brick which will shine forward when activated. All-in-all, it's an impressively spooky alternative to an actual Star Wars-themed build. The set is available at the LEGO Store for $29.99 and you can grab instructions for Barber's Millennium Falcon version from Rebrickable for $3 more .

Set #40872 is currently a LEGO Exclusive which means you can only buy it at the LEGO Store. That's generally the best place to buy LEGO sets , but because the price is under $30, it's not eligible for any of the gifts with purchase available now.

articles.title: Vampire Hunter D Returns: The Cult-Classic Horror Series Finds New Life in 2026
articles.summary: With a new Western comic book series in the works and a theatrical rerelease slated for 2027, the Vampire Hunter D franchise is suddenly back in the spotlight.
articles.body:
Vampire Hunter D is a franchise that has enjoyed a long, healthy lifespan as a series of Japanese light novels, but has never really been explored to its fullest in other media. The last Vampire Hunter D film to be released was 2001's Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust. Luckily for fans of the wandering hero known only as D, there's been some new momentum surrounding the franchise recently, including both a brand-new Western comics series and a theatrical rerelease.

First up, Dark Horse Comics is releasing a new miniseries called Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood. The series isn't an adaptation of one of Hideyuki Kikuchi's novels, but is rather an original story set in that post-apocalyptic universe. Fortress of Blood is written by Chris Condon (That Texas Blood) and illustrated by Filipe Andrade (The Many Deaths of Laila Starr).

Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood #1 Cover Art Gallery

The creative team also includes colorist Jordie Bellaire and letterer Frank Cvetkovic. Andrade illustrated the main cover for issue #1, with variants by Riccardo Federici and Yoshitaka Amano. Here's Dark Horse's official summary of the first issue:

The first official comic series based on Hideyuki Kikuchi’s Vampire Hunter D! A vampire lord has marshalled his forces and is marching on human settlements aiming to leave no survivors! One thing stands among his path to the next city—the old fortress. There, a family of outcasts will need to buy enough time for the humans to flee. And wandering this same path is the beautiful, indomitable hunter—half-human, half-vampire—known as D.

Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood #1 will be released on December 16. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .

On the film front, GKIDS revealed that Bloodlust is getting a theatrical rerelease in 2027, just after the film's 25th anniversary.

GKIDS is proud to announce the acquisition of North American rights to VAMPIRE HUNTER D: BLOODLUST. 🩸 The rarely-screened gothic horror classic from Yoshiaki Kawajiri and MADHOUSE will get a full theatrical release in 2027. More details soon! https://t.co/UAi0WXpGqN pic.twitter.com/jTfCJ7qDWl — GKIDS Films (@GKIDSfilms) August 22, 2026

GKIDS is proud to announce the acquisition of North American rights to VAMPIRE HUNTER D: BLOODLUST. 🩸 The rarely-screened gothic horror classic from Yoshiaki Kawajiri and MADHOUSE will get a full theatrical release in 2027. More details soon! https://t.co/UAi0WXpGqN pic.twitter.com/jTfCJ7qDWl

There are no further details regarding a release date or possible 4k Blu-ray release, but hopefully Bloodlust returning to theaters will spark new interest in the series and pave the way for another film or anime series. Previously, an anime called Vampire Hunter D: Resurrection was announced in 2015, but work on the series seemingly stalled out during the COVID-19 pandemic.

For more on this cult-favorite franchise, check out IGN's Hidden Treasures retrospective on Vampire Hunter D .
